project: Budget Tracker - WBS Task & Progress Manager

stories.title: Create hierarchical tasks
stories.description: As a project manager, I want to create tasks organized into 3 hierarchical levels (major > middle > minor) so that I can represent a WBS structure.
acceptance_criteria: Can create a Level 1 (major) task with name, description, dates, and effort
Can create a Level 2 (middle) task under a Level 1 parent
Can create a Level 3 (minor) task under a Level 2 parent
Cannot create a Level 4 task (rejected with error)
Each task has auto-assigned level based on parent
New tasks have status 'not_started' and progress 0%

stories.title: Input planned schedules
stories.description: As a user, I want to input planned start/end dates and planned effort (hours) for each task so that I can set baseline schedules.
acceptance_criteria: Can set planned_start_date and planned_end_date in YYYY-MM-DD format
Can set planned_effort_hours as a positive number
End date validation: must be >= start date
Effort validation: must be >= 0
Inline editing: click on date/effort field to edit directly
Auto-save on blur or Enter key

stories.title: Record daily actuals
stories.description: As a user, I want to record daily actual effort/progress for each task so that I can track real performance against plans.
acceptance_criteria: Can record actual hours for a specific date on any task
Can add optional notes to the daily record
One entry per task per day (upsert: second entry updates the first)
Actual hours must be > 0 and <= 24
Work date defaults to today
Cannot record for dates more than 1 day in the future
Recording an actual triggers progress recalculation

stories.title: View automatic progress calculation
stories.description: As a user, I want to see automatic progress rate calculation (%) for each task and its parent items so that I know how far along we are.
acceptance_criteria: Leaf task progress = (cumulative actual hours / planned effort) * 100, capped at 100%
Parent progress = weighted average of children (by planned effort)
If planned effort is 0: progress is 0% unless status is completed (100%)
If children have no planned effort: equal-weight average
Progress bar is displayed on every task row
Progress percentage is shown as number next to the bar

stories.title: View delay indicators
stories.description: As a user, I want to see delay rate indicators so that I can identify tasks that are behind schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks past due date with < 100% progress show 'OVERDUE' (red)
Tasks with > 80% duration elapsed and < 60% progress show 'AT RISK' (yellow)
Tasks on track show 'ON TRACK' (green)
Tasks without dates show no delay indicator
Delay status is recalculated on each page load

stories.title: Visual delay warnings
stories.description: As a user, I want delayed tasks to display visual warnings (red/yellow indicators) so that I can take corrective action quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Yellow badge with warning icon for 'at_risk' tasks
Red badge with alert icon for 'overdue' tasks
Badges are visible on task list rows
Dashboard shows count and list of delayed tasks

stories.title: Gray-out completed tasks
stories.description: As a user, I want completed tasks to appear grayed out so that I can visually distinguish completed work from active work at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: Completed tasks have reduced opacity (0.55)
Task name has strikethrough decoration
Status badge shows green 'Done' indicator
Completed tasks are still visible (not hidden) in the list
Completed tasks can still be clicked for drill-down

stories.title: Edit and delete tasks
stories.description: As a user, I want to edit, update, and delete tasks and their schedules after creation so that I can correct mistakes and adapt to changes.
acceptance_criteria: Can edit any task property (name, description, dates, effort, status)
Inline editing for dates and effort fields
Modal editing for full task details
Delete shows confirmation dialog
Deleting a parent task deletes all children (cascade)
Soft delete: data is preserved with is_deleted flag
After delete, parent progress is recalculated

stories.title: Drill-down navigation
stories.description: As a user, I want the top page to show all major items, and clicking one drills down to its children so that navigation follows the WBS hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: Top page shows all Level 1 tasks with summary progress
Clicking a Level 1 task shows its Level 2 children
Clicking a Level 2 task shows its Level 3 children
Breadcrumb shows full path: Home > Major > Middle
Clicking any breadcrumb segment navigates to that level
Browser back button navigates correctly

stories.title: LAN access
stories.description: As a team member on the same LAN, I want to view the project status from my own computer so that I stay informed without needing the host machine.
acceptance_criteria: Server listens on 0.0.0.0 for LAN access
On startup, local IP address and port are displayed
Other devices on the same LAN can access the app via IP:port
CORS is configured to allow LAN origins
Full read/write access from LAN (no authentication)

stories.title: Dashboard overview
stories.description: As a user, I want a dashboard page showing overall project progress summary so that I get a quick snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Shows total tasks count
Shows completed / in-progress / not-started counts
Shows overall progress percentage with progress bar
Shows count and list of delayed tasks
Shows summary of all Level 1 tasks with mini progress bars
Auto-refreshes data on page load

stories.title: Search and filter tasks
stories.description: As a user, I want to filter and search tasks by name, status, or date range so that I can find specific items quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Text search filters tasks by name (case-insensitive)
Status dropdown filters by not_started / in_progress / completed
Filters work within the current drill-down level
Filters are combinable (AND logic)
Clearing search shows all tasks
Filtering is instant (client-side)

stories.title: Color-coded date indicators
stories.description: As a user, I want color-coded due date indicators so that urgency is immediately visible.
acceptance_criteria: Green: On track (within schedule)
Yellow: At risk (behind expected progress)
Red: Overdue (past due date with incomplete progress)
No color: No dates set or task not started
